description: This file defines the SubBinary class, which is a specific implementation of a binary expression node representing subtraction in the Twig templating engine. It extends an abstract binary class and provides the operator method to output the minus sign.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Binary\SubBinary
classes.description: A binary node representing subtraction operation in the Twig expression tree.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string '-' to represent the subtraction operator in the compiled template.
